scope: Official-source supplementation for the three SEGi public programmes that remain without a unique total tuition after the 2026 fee-sheet backfill.
decision: No additional tuition amount was written because SEGi official sources did not publish a unique total tuition for these exact programmes.

sourcePolicy.accepted: Exact official programme page, exact official SEGi brochure/PDF, or official SEGi fee/admission source that publishes a programme-specific total tuition.
sourcePolicy.rejected: Application fee, visa fee, registration fee, generic financial-aid text, adjacent programme fee, third-party fee, or inferred amount.

officialSourcesChecked.title: SEGi official Postgraduate Studies brochure
officialSourcesChecked.finding: Programme identities and descriptions are present; no RM/MYR total tuition amount is published for the unresolved postgraduate programmes.

officialSourcesChecked.title: SEGi official Business & Accounting brochure
officialSourcesChecked.finding: Bachelor of Business Analytics ODL identity and curriculum are present; no RM/MYR total tuition amount is published.

officialSourcesChecked.title: SEGi official international-student page
officialSourcesChecked.finding: Publishes admission and international-student visa application fees only; not usable as programme tuition.
